name: Выстрел из лука
subject: A wooden recurved longbow bent under tension; a brown leather-gloved left hand firmly grasps its central grip while a fletched wooden arrow lies correctly on the arrow rest, nocked to the drawn string pulled back by a second hand. Arrow aims upper-right, green ranger wrist cloth, silver broadhead. Physically coherent bow/string/arrow, no multiple shots or magic. Deep forest/navy background.
caption: Натянутый деревянный лук и одна стрела с правильным положением тетивы.
